input_state: (raw_aux, sector k, turn_orientation eps) after coherent collapse, before storing the next segment endpoint
missing_budget: m=1-B(raw_aux); completion is admissible only when m>=0

axis_encounter.forward: exit axis of sector k, namely d_(k+1)
axis_encounter.reverse: entry axis of sector k, namely d_k
axis_encounter.typing: This is read from the discrete target turn-state (sector,orientation), not from source Euclidean distance or angle.

rule: COMPLETE(raw,k,eps)=raw + m*axis_encounter(k,eps) when m>=0 and the addition is one signed primitive channel step per unit of missing budget.
DOWN_case: raw=0, B=0, m=1, so forward completion is exactly d_(k+1) and reverse completion is d_k.
exact_axis_case: If the precollapse input is already an integer axis anchor then B=1, m=0 and no extra step is added.
UP_case: raw=d_k+d_(k+1), B=2 gives m=-1; completion is undefined because an axis-completion operation may fill a deficit but may not delete overlength budget.
native_storage: Auxiliary zero is only an internal computation chart state. The composed DOWN+COMPLETE update stores the resulting A1 native anchor and never stores native coordinate 0.
covariance: R6 transports the rule sectorwise; reversing turn orientation exchanges exit/entry axis and gives the inverse cycle.
noncircularity: The rule depends only on target budget deficit and the sector/orientation axis encounter. It contains no closure lookup, radius table, source metric, or desired endpoint list beyond the already-frozen local axis incidence.
